message: kukulu_release could not fast-forward main because the clean-room hooks append to .kukulu/cleanroom/log.jsonl on every tool call (and the guard forbids stashing it), so it resolved the stale local PR #1 merge (aa84841) and refused with "no numbered entry"; the operator had to stash the log and fast-forward by hand twice before v0.2.0 released.

After a flight, kukulu_release needs the base branch checked out, but leaving the build branch was blocked by hook-modified .kukulu/cleanroom/log.jsonl and the guard refuses to stash it; the operator had to stash by hand twice, and since archiving removes that log from the base branch the two stashes can never be popped back (modify/delete), so those entries are stranded.

With local main 76 commits behind origin, kukulu_release refused with "CHANGELOG.md at aa84841 has no numbered entry" (aa84841 is the previous flight's PR #1 merge) instead of saying the local base lacks the flight's merge commit or that its own fast-forward failed; the real cause took two extra round trips to find.

The run policy said pr=draft, yet the default policies.finalize "auto" marked the PR ready and tried auto-merge on a repo that disallows it, which the owner did not expect for a headless run; policies can only be set in docs/kukulu.json, which the planner must leave policies out of and the guard then protects, so an owner cannot set finalize durably except via SPEC text or a global/profile default (none exists).

verify-attestation printed "implementer: the endpoint reported claude-sonnet-5-5; routing declared sonnet" as a note, but sonnet is an alias that resolves to claude-sonnet-5-5, which the owner confirms is intended; the verifier should resolve alias families and report a mismatch only when the reported model is outside the declared alias's family.
